summary: Iteration 25 - Website Templates feature testing completed. All 10 templates load correctly with distinct visual styles. Full booking flow works on all templates. Admin dashboard template gallery shows all templates with working filter tabs and Preview/Copy URL buttons.
passed_tests: Template booking-classic loads with blue Booking.com style (header: rgb(0, 59, 149), accent: rgb(0, 108, 228))
Template booking-business loads with dark navy theme (header: rgb(26, 31, 54), accent: rgb(84, 105, 212)), Business Travel Ready badge visible
Template booking-resort loads with teal/green resort theme (header: rgb(12, 110, 93), accent: rgb(15, 166, 139)), Resort & Spa badge visible
Template booking-boutique loads with dark/gold boutique theme (header: rgb(44, 44, 44), accent: rgb(184, 134, 11)), Boutique Collection badge visible
Template airbnb-modern loads with photo-grid layout, white header, red Airbnb accent (rgb(255, 56, 92))
Template airbnb-experience loads with photo-grid layout, white header, pink accent (rgb(226, 28, 94))
Template expedia-classic loads with navy header (rgb(29, 60, 110)), yellow accent (rgb(245, 178, 31)), Member Price Available badge visible
Template expedia-premium loads with dark navy header (rgb(27, 38, 64)), gold accent (rgb(201, 168, 76))
Template hotels-rewards loads with red Hotels.com style (header: rgb(211, 47, 47)), Collect stamps with every stay badge visible
Template hotels-family loads with purple header (rgb(92, 107, 192)), orange accent (rgb(255, 112, 67)), Family Friendly Property badge visible
All 10 templates have working Search button that transitions to room selection
Full booking flow works: Search -> Select Room -> Guest Details -> Pay at Hotel -> Confirmation (tested on booking-classic)
Booking confirmation shows MHB-XXXXXXXX reference format
Admin login works with admin@hotelbox.com / HotelAdmin2026!
Admin dashboard: Website Templates sidebar item present and clickable
Admin dashboard: Template gallery shows all 10 templates
Admin dashboard: Filter tabs work - All Templates (10), Booking.com Style (4), Airbnb Style (2), Expedia Style (2), Hotels.com Style (2)
Admin dashboard: Clicking Booking.com filter shows only 4 templates
Admin dashboard: Preview button present for each template
Admin dashboard: Copy URL button present for each template
Admin dashboard: Active booking page URL displayed at top of gallery
Backend API: GET /api/booking/property/{property_id} returns property info
Backend API: GET /api/booking/rooms/{property_id} returns available rooms
Backend API: POST /api/booking/reserve creates booking successfully
seed_data_creation: Test booking created with TEST_Template_User prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: 10 website templates fully implemented and tested. Templates are accessed via /book?property={property_id}&template={templateId}. Template IDs: booking-classic, booking-business, booking-resort, booking-boutique, airbnb-modern, airbnb-experience, expedia-classic, expedia-premium, hotels-rewards, hotels-family. Admin dashboard has 'Website Templates' sidebar item under SETTINGS section that opens TemplateGallery component. All templates share the same booking flow but with different visual styles.
